title: Reusing Multimodal Agents: Efficient Evaluation of Sound Designs in Games
abstract: arXiv:2610.27670v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper introduces a novel framework for efficiently evaluating in-game sound designs using multimodal learning and reinforcement learning. Sound design significantly influences gameplay and accessibility; however, objective evaluation methods, defined here as automated assessments based on agent performance rather than human ratings, often require retraining agents from scratch for each sound design. Our approach first pre-trains a multimodal encoder that encodes visual and auditory information into a shared latent space. A reinforcement learning agent is then trained using this latent representation. We fine-tune the multimodal encoder for each sound design while keeping the trained policy fixed, allowing us to isolate the effects of sound changes on agent behavior. translated_title: 复用多模态智能体：游戏中声音设计的高效评估
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的框架，利用多模态学习和强化学习来高效评估游戏内的声音设计。声音设计对游戏玩法和可访问性有重要影响；然而，客观评估方法（本文将其定义为基于智能体表现而非人类评分的自动化评估）通常需要针对每种声音设计从头重新训练智能体。我们的方法首先预训练一个多模态编码器，将视觉和听觉信息编码到共享的潜在空间中，然后使用该潜在表示来训练强化学习智能体。针对每种声音设计，我们在保持已训练策略固定不变的同时对多模态编码器进行微调，从而能够将声音变化对智能体行为的影响隔离开来。为评估所提出的方法，我们在多个类型的游戏中进行了实验，比较了盲智能体（即仅使用声音输入的智能体）的表现。
tldr: 提出一种通过预训练多模态编码器、固定强化学习策略而仅微调编码器的框架，从而复用智能体以高效评估游戏中声音设计变化的影响。
en_tdlr: A novel framework that efficiently evaluates in-game sound designs by pre-training a multimodal encoder and fine-tuning only the encoder while keeping the RL policy fixed, enabling agent reuse across sound designs.
